#Data Pre-processing:

In this step, we want to:

1. Read the data
```{r}
ev_data <- read.csv("Data/EV_Charging/EV_Charging_Data-_Municipal_Lots_and_Garages_20251106.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
```

2. Choose ID tag as an unique identifier:
```{r}

# Choose ID_tag as unique identifier
# Check if ID_tag is unique
sum(duplicated(ev_data$`ID Tag`))
# Keep only the first row per ID_tag
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  distinct(`ID Tag`, .keep_all = TRUE)

```

3. Remove Columns and rows that are not relevent to our experiment:
```{r}
# Remove columns: Driver_id, Invalidity_reason, country
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  select(-`Driver ID`, -`Invalidity Reason`, -`Country`)

# Remove rows where session_status is “Disconnected”
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  filter(`Session Status` != "DISCONNECTED")

# Keep Station_name and drop Charger_id
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  select(-`Charge Box ID`)

# Check null values and drop rows with any NA
colSums(is.na(ev_data))
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()
```

4.Convert type from chr to numeric
```{r}
#change Charge Duration (min) to numeric
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(`Charge Duration (min)` = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", `Charge Duration (min)`)))
#change Connected Duration (min) to numeric
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(`Connected Duration (min)` = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", `Connected Duration (min)`)))
```

5. Add columns based on Dates
```{r}

# Sort the data based on date
ev_data$Date <- as.Date(ev_data$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  arrange(Date)

# Add weekday column
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(weekday = weekdays(Date))

# Add is_weekend
weekends <- c("Saturday", "Sunday")
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(
    is_weekend = weekday %in% weekends
  )

# Add holidays column for year 2024
# Need to work on this!!
holidays_2024 <- as.Date(c(
  "2024-01-01", # New Year's Day
  "2024-01-15", # MLK Day
  "2024-02-19", # Presidents' Day
  "2024-05-27", # Memorial Day
  "2024-06-19", # Juneteenth
  "2024-07-04", # Independence Day
  "2024-09-02", # Labor Day
  "2024-10-14", # Columbus/Indigenous Peoples' Day
  "2024-11-11", # Veterans Day
  "2024-11-28", # Thanksgiving
  "2024-12-25"  # Christmas
))

ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(
    is_holiday_2024 = Date %in% holidays_2024
  )


```


6. Clean the location names:

```{r}

# Standardize location names
ev_data <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Location Name` = case_when(
      # Jerome Gun Hill Road variations
      grepl("JGU|Jerome.*Gun Hill", `Location Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        "Jerome Gun Hill Road Municipal Parking Garage",
      
      # Bay Ridge variations
      grepl("BRI|Bay Ridge", `Location Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        "Bay Ridge Municipal Parking Garage",
      
      # Delancey and Essex variations
      grepl("DES|Delancey.*Essex", `Location Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        "Delancey and Essex Municipal Parking Garage",
      
      # Queens Borough Hall variations
      grepl("QBO|Queensboro Hall|Queens Borough Hall", `Location Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        "Queens Borough Hall Municipal Parking Garage",
      
      # Jerome 190th Street variations
      grepl("JON|Jerome.*190", `Location Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        "Jerome 190th Street Municipal Parking Garage",
      
      # St. George Courthouse variations
      grepl("SGE|St\\.? George", `Location Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        "St. George Courthouse Garage",
      
      # Court Square variations
      grepl("CSQ|Court Square", `Location Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        "Court Square Municipal Parking Garage",
      
      # Queens Family Court variations
      grepl("QFA|Queens Family Court", `Location Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 
        "Queens Family Court Municipal Garage",
      
      # Handle N/A
      `Location Name` == "N/A" ~ NA_character_,
      
      # Keep everything else as is
      TRUE ~ `Location Name`
    )
  )

# Check the results
unique(ev_data$`Location Name`)

# Count how many of each location
ev_data %>% count(`Location Name`, sort = TRUE)

```

7. Data info:

```{r}

head(ev_data, 10)
# Print column names nicely
cat("Column names:\n")
cat(paste(1:length(names(ev_data)), names(ev_data), sep = ". "), sep = "\n")

write.csv(ev_data, "EV_data_processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# Descriptive Analysis

### Frequency Tables

1.⁠ ⁠Frequency table → Session Status distribution; Day of the week distribution; Weekday vs. Weekend distribution; Location distribution; Charging Start Hours distribution; Charging End Hours distribution

```{r}
# 1. Session Status distribution
session_status_freq <- ev_data %>%
  count(`Session Status`, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    percentage = round(percentage, 2)
  )

# Session Status bar chart
ggplot(session_status_freq, aes(x = reorder(`Session Status`, -n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", percentage, "%)")), vjust = -0.5) + # Label of count and percentage
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + # Additional space to account for labels
  labs(title = "Session Status Distribution", x = "Status", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 2. Day of the week distribution
weekday_freq <- ev_data %>%
  count(weekday, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    percentage = round(percentage, 2)
  )

# Day of the week bar chart
ggplot(weekday_freq, aes(x = reorder(weekday, -n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "darkgreen") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", percentage, "%)")), vjust = -0.5) + # Label of count and percentage
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + # Additional space to account for labels
  labs(title = "Weekday Distribution", x = "Day", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. Weekday vs. Weekend distribution
weekend_freq <- ev_data %>%
  count(is_weekend, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    percentage = round(percentage, 2),
    type_of_day = ifelse(is_weekend == TRUE, "Weekend", "Weekday") 
  )

# Weekday vs. Weekend bar chart
ggplot(weekend_freq, aes(x = reorder(type_of_day, -n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "seagreen") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", percentage, "%)")), vjust = -0.5) + # Label of count and percentage
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + # Additional space to account for labels
  labs(title = "Weekday vs Weekend", x = "Type", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 4. Location distribution
location_freq <- ev_data %>%
  count(`Location Name`, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    percentage = round(percentage, 2)
  )

# Location bar chart
ggplot(location_freq, aes(x = reorder(`Location Name`, -n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "coral") +
  coord_flip() +  # Flip for better readability
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", percentage, "%)")), hjust = -0.1) + # Label of count and percentage
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.30))) + # Additional space to account for labels
  labs(title = "Location Distribution", x = "Location", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 5. Charging Start Hours distribution
hourly_freq <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(
    time_object = hms(`Connected Time`),
    hour_start = hour(time_object)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hour_start)) %>%
  count(hour_start) 

hourly_freq$hour_start <- factor(hourly_freq$hour_start, levels = 0:23)

# Charging Start Hours Bar Chart
ggplot(hourly_freq, aes(x = hour_start, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "darkviolet") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) + # Label of count
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + # Additional space to account for labels
  labs(title = "Peak Charging Start Times", x = "Hour of Day (24h)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 6. Charging End Hours distribution
end_hourly_freq <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(
    time_object = hms(`Disconnected Time`),
    hour_end = hour(time_object)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hour_end)) %>%
  count(hour_end)

end_hourly_freq$hour_end <- factor(end_hourly_freq$hour_end, levels = 0:23)

# Charging End Hours Bar Chart
ggplot(end_hourly_freq, aes(x = hour_end, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "darkred") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) + # Label of count
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + # Additional space to account for labels
  labs(title = "Peak Charging End Times", x = "Hour of Day (24h)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
### Center and Dispersion Statistics

# Function to calculate mode (R doesn't have a built-in mode function)
get_mode <- function(x) {
  x <- na.omit(x)
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

# Function to calculate all statistics for a variable
calc_stats <- function(x, var_name) {
  x <- na.omit(x)
  
  data.frame(
    Variable = var_name,
    Mean = round(mean(x), 3),
    Median = round(median(x), 3),
    Mode = round(get_mode(x), 3),
    Trimmed_Mean_10pct = round(mean(x, trim = 0.10), 3),
    IQR = round(IQR(x), 3),
    Variance = round(var(x), 3),
    Std_Dev = round(sd(x), 3),
    CV = round((sd(x) / mean(x)) * 100, 2),  # Coefficient of Variation as percentage
    Skewness = round(skewness(x), 3)
  )
}

# Calculate statistics for Energy Provided and Charge Duration
energy_stats <- calc_stats(ev_data$`Energy Provided (kWh)`, "Energy Provided (kWh)")
duration_stats <- calc_stats(ev_data$`Charge Duration (min)`, "Charge Duration (min)")

# Combine into one table
summary_stats <- rbind(energy_stats, duration_stats)

# Display the table
kable(summary_stats, 
      caption = "Summary Statistics: Measures of Center and Dispersion",
      col.names = c("Variable", "Mean", "Median", "Mode", "Trimmed Mean (10%)", 
                    "IQR", "Variance", "Std Dev", "CV (%)", "Skewness"),
      align = "lrrrrrrrrr") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                position = "center")
```



```{r}
# Total Energy Consumed by Day of Week
energy_by_day <- ev_data %>%
  group_by(weekday) %>%
  summarise(
    total_energy = sum(`Energy Provided (kWh)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_sessions = n(),
    avg_energy = mean(`Energy Provided (kWh)`, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_energy_rounded = round(total_energy, 0),
    avg_energy_rounded = round(avg_energy, 2)
  )

# Bar plot of Total Energy by Weekday
ggplot(energy_by_day, aes(x = weekday, y = total_energy, fill = weekday)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(format(total_energy_rounded, big.mark = ","), " kWh")), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "Total Energy Consumed by Day of Week",
       x = "Day of Week",
       y = "Total Energy (kWh)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```

```{r}
### Heatmap of Temporal Usage (Weekday × Hour of Day)

# Prepare data: extract hour and summarize
temporal_data <- ev_data %>%
  mutate(
    time_object = hms(`Connected Time`),
    hour = hour(time_object)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hour)) %>%
  group_by(weekday, hour) %>%
  summarise(
    num_sessions = n(),
    avg_energy = round(mean(`Energy Provided (kWh)`, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    total_energy = round(sum(`Energy Provided (kWh)`, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Ensure proper weekday order
temporal_data$weekday <- factor(temporal_data$weekday,
                                 levels = c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday",
                                            "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"))

# 1. Heatmap: Number of Sessions by Weekday × Hour
ggplot(temporal_data, aes(x = hour, y = weekday, fill = num_sessions)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = num_sessions), size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightyellow", high = "darkred") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  labs(title = "Number of Charging Sessions by Day and Hour",
       subtitle = "Identifying peak charging times",
       x = "Hour of Day (24h)",
       y = "Day of Week",
       fill = "Sessions") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

# 2. Heatmap: Average Energy per Session by Weekday × Hour
ggplot(temporal_data, aes(x = hour, y = weekday, fill = avg_energy)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = avg_energy), size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  labs(title = "Average Energy per Session by Day and Hour",
       subtitle = "When do longer/fuller charges happen?",
       x = "Hour of Day (24h)",
       y = "Day of Week",
       fill = "Avg kWh") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

# 3. Heatmap: Total Energy by Weekday × Hour
ggplot(temporal_data, aes(x = hour, y = weekday, fill = total_energy)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightgreen", high = "darkgreen") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  labs(title = "Total Energy Consumed by Day and Hour",
       subtitle = "Grid demand patterns",
       x = "Hour of Day (24h)",
       y = "Day of Week",
       fill = "Total kWh") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```
